newsitem.title: USA: ICN settles class action suit.
newsitem.headline: ICN settles class action suit.

text.p: ICN Pharmaceuticals Inc said Thursday it had settled a two-year-old class action lawsuit.

ICN said in a statement that under the settlement, which is subject to approval of the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California, it will pay a total of $15 million, funded in part by its insurance carrier.
The settlement will be taken as a non-recurring charge against second quarter 1997 earnings. Even with the charge ICN said its earnings should be within analysts' expectations.
Analysts expect ICN to earn $0.52 a share in its second quarter with a range of $0.47 a share to $0.59 a share, according to First Call.
